post.summary: Get multiple events in one call
post.description:
Fetch multiple events by id in a single round-trip — for agents that
already have a list of ids (e.g. from GET /v1/events) and want full detail
for each without issuing one GET per event.

Body: {"event_ids": [1, 2, 3], "include_odds": bool, "include_intelligence": bool, "bookmaker": str}
Max 25 ids per call. Duplicate ids are billed once. Credits are the sum of
each event's normal GET /v1/events/{id} cost — billing fairness applies
per event (unavailable odds/intelligence are free; ids that don't exist
cost nothing and are returned under "not_found").

parameters.name: bookmaker

schema.description: Bookmaker to use for market.price and market.line in the response. Overrides the system default (pinnacle). Valid values: pinnacle, fanduel, draftkings, betmgm, caesars, bet365, circa, hardrock, betonline. Applies to the points-model shape only — probability-model sports (soccer/MLS) always report the book their assessment was priced against, since quoting a different book's price beside a probability computed from another would misstate fair_price and edge.
schema.title: Bookmaker

parameters.description: Bookmaker to use for market.price and market.line in the response. Overrides the system default (pinnacle). Valid values: pinnacle, fanduel, draftkings, betmgm, caesars, bet365, circa, hardrock, betonline. Applies to the points-model shape only — probability-model sports (soccer/MLS) always report the book their assessment was priced against, since quoting a different book's price beside a probability computed from another would misstate fair_price and edge.

200.description:
Bet-level probabilities and market odds for all bet tokens. bets[] comes in two shapes; branch on the presence of `probability` (probability model) vs. `confidence_score` (points model), or on `sport`/`league`. Full per-field definitions are on the BetIntelligence schema. 

**Probability model — currently soccer/MLS only:** bets[] carries probability, interval, p_model, p_market, blend_w, fair_price, edge, sufficiency, phase, model_version, tier, and drivers — and no confidence_score, coverage, signals, or validator. `probability` is a calibrated probability whose outcomes sum to 1 within a market; `p_market` is the de-vigged market price. Where no fitted model has yet been cleared for a league, `blend_w` is 0, `probability` equals `p_market`, and `p_model`/`edge`/`tier` are null — a probability taken from the market has no honest edge against the price it came from. `drivers` is normally empty in that case; two exceptions carry `effect: 0` and never move probability: Stage 6 Match Context drivers (`soccer.match_context.*`), which may cite the Fact Ledger, and `soccer.cross_book_edge`, the market-anchored price gap already published in `edges_by_book`/`best_edge` (a line-shopping signal, not an expected-value claim). Those fields populate per league and per bet token as models clear out-of-sample validation. The `bookmaker` query parameter does not apply to this shape: assessments are priced against a fixed book, reported as `odds_source` and per-bet `market.book`. 

**Points model — every other sport/league:** bets[] carries confidence_score, coverage, tier, signals, validator, narrative, rationale, and attribution. MLB tokens: ML_P1 (home), ML_P2 (away), SPREAD_P1, SPREAD_P2, OVER, UNDER. Tennis tokens: ML_P1, ML_P2, SPREAD_P1, SPREAD_P2, OVER, UNDER. Soccer tokens: ML_HOME, ML_AWAY, ML_DRAW, SPREAD_HOME, SPREAD_AWAY, OVER, UNDER. signal_* keys are shared fields that mean different things per sport (e.g. signal_serve_rtn is tennis Serve/Return but soccer Attack/Defense Edge) — for NFL, NCAAF, and soccer, bets[].signals._labels maps each present key to its sport-specific label; omitted for tennis/MLB. 

In both shapes, match-level tokens (OVER, UNDER, ML_DRAW) carry no participant attribution: player_role, player_id, team_id, and player_name are null, since those bets are not about either side. 

Both shapes also include the event-level analyst_take and match_overview narratives. If no intelligence has been computed for this event yet, returns 200 with available=false and is NOT charged (X-Credits-Used: 0).

get.summary: Get raw team/match statistics for an event (Data layer)
get.description: Soccer and MLB. Returns deterministic aggregates from completed results and box scores already ingested — no market/odds data (see /odds) and no scoring/confidence (see /intelligence). Soccer: team strength (club: rank/GD/W-D-L; WC: fifa_rank), recent form, H2H, rest days, home/away splits, boxscore rates (shots/SoT for&against, possession, save_rate), strength-of-schedule (sos), and lineups/formation. MLB: season W/L record + run differential, recent form, H2H, rest days, team batting/pitching rates (rates_l5/rates_season — AVG/ERA/WHIP/K9/BB9 and component counts), today's starting pitcher's season ERA/WHIP/K9/BB9, and lineup (batting order + starting pitcher + subs). Explicit windows on both. available:false is free.

200.description: Deterministic, reproducible team and match statistics computed from completed results and box scores already ingested from the public record. Soccer: team strength, recent form, head-to-head history, rest days, home/away splits, per-game boxscore rates (shots/SoT for & against, possession, corners, cards, save rate) over explicit windows (rates_l5 / rates_season), club league-table rank/GD/W-D-L, strength-of-schedule (avg opponent PPG), and lineups/formation when ingested. MLB: season-to-date W/L record + run differential, recent form, head-to-head history, rest days, team batting/pitching rate aggregates (rates_l5 / rates_season), the game's starting pitcher's own season ERA/WHIP/K9/BB9, and lineup (batting order + starting pitcher + in-game subs) when ingested from completed-game box scores (Path A is post-final only — no pregame probable pitchers). Contains no market/odds data (see GET /v1/events/{id}/odds for that) and no scoring, weighting, confidence, or narrative — that judgment layer lives at GET /v1/events/{id}/intelligence, which scores related inputs (soccer scores these same Data-layer fields; MLB intelligence still largely live-fetches overlapping signals). Currently available for soccer and MLB only. If an event has too few completed games for a given field, that field returns null (with games: 0 on rate blocks) rather than the whole call failing.

key.title: Key
key.description: Full API key — returned once on create.

event_ids.title: Event Ids
event_ids.description: Event ids to fetch (max 25). Duplicates are billed once.

include_odds.title: Include Odds
include_odds.description: Inline current odds on each event. Scoped by bookmaker (default: pinnacle). +1 credit per event for a single book when available; +2 for bookmaker=all or a comma-separated list.

include_intelligence.title: Include Intelligence
include_intelligence.description: Inline bet intelligence on each event (+1 credit per event when available).

bookmaker.title: Bookmaker
bookmaker.description: Bookmaker for inlined odds and intelligence market prices. Defaults to pinnacle; 'all' or a comma-separated list for multiple books.

not_found.title: Not Found
not_found.description: Requested event_ids that don't exist. Never billed.

bet_type.title: Bet Type
bet_type.description: Canonical bet token, e.g. ML_HOME/ML_AWAY/ML_DRAW (soccer), ML_P1/ML_P2 (head-to-head sports), SPREAD_HOME/SPREAD_AWAY, OVER, UNDER.

player_role.title: Player Role
player_role.description: 'home'/'away' for team sports or 'p1'/'p2' for head-to-head sports. Null for match-level tokens (OVER, UNDER, ML_DRAW), which are not about either side.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: Player ID when this bet is about an individual player; null for team bets and match-level tokens (OVER, UNDER, ML_DRAW).

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: Team ID when this bet is about a team; null for individual-player bets and match-level tokens (OVER, UNDER, ML_DRAW). A draw is not a bet on either team, so ML_DRAW carries no team_id — safe to sum exposure by team_id across bets without double-counting the draw.

player_name.title: Player Name
player_name.description: Display name of the player or team this bet is about; null for match-level tokens (OVER, UNDER, ML_DRAW). Duplicates `players[player_role].name` for convenience when flattening bets[].

market.title: Market
market.description: Market quote used for this bet: {price: American odds, line: handicap/total line or null for moneyline, book: bookmaker slug when known}. For predictive-framework sports `book` is always populated from the assessment; for legacy sports it may be omitted. Present for every sport.

computed_at.title: Computed At
computed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this bet's numbers last materially changed — not when they were last checked. The publisher re-runs on a schedule but only rewrites a row when the price, line, or probability moves beyond a tolerance, so an older `computed_at` means 'unchanged since', not 'stale'. Values legitimately differ between bets on the same event because each market moves independently.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Confidence tier: 'very_high', 'strong', 'moderate', or 'avoid'. Present for both legacy and predictive-framework sports. For predictive-framework sports it is null whenever `edge` is null — a tier ranks a bet against its price, so there is nothing to rank without an edge.

confidence_score.title: Confidence Score
confidence_score.description: Legacy points-engine confidence score, 0-1. A points fraction, not a calibrated probability. Legacy sports only — see `probability` for predictive-framework sports.

confidence_score_pre_validator.title: Confidence Score Pre Validator
confidence_score_pre_validator.description: Legacy confidence_score before the qualitative validator applied its delta. Legacy sports only.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Legacy signal-coverage fraction, 0-1 — how many of the expected signal_* columns were populated for this bet. Legacy sports only — superseded by the continuous `sufficiency` for predictive-framework sports, which widens the interval instead of gating the response.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Legacy per-signal point breakdown (signal_research, signal_form, etc.); the same DB columns mean different things per sport — see `signals._labels` when present. Legacy sports only — superseded by `drivers` for predictive-framework sports.

validator.title: Validator
validator.description: Legacy qualitative-validator verdict: {stance, confidence, delta, validated_at}. Legacy sports only.

narrative.title: Narrative
narrative.description: Legacy per-bet narrative sentence generated alongside the validator pass. Legacy sports only.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Legacy human-readable rationale bullets built from `signals`. Legacy sports only.

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.description: Attribution keys backing `rationale`, in the same order. Legacy sports only.

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: Published probability for this outcome, 0-1. Equals `p_market` (the de-vigged market price) whenever `blend_w` is 0, which is the case for every league that does not yet have a fitted model that beat the market out-of-sample; otherwise it is the log-space blend of `p_model` and `p_market` at weight `blend_w`. Outcomes of the same market (e.g. ML_HOME + ML_DRAW + ML_AWAY) are blended jointly and sum to 1. Predictive-framework sports only.

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: [lo, hi] band around `probability`, 0-1. Width is driven by `sufficiency`, so read it as 'how much evidence backs this number', not as a statistical confidence interval — the constants are calibrated against realised outcomes, not derived analytically. When `blend_w` is 0 the band reflects how mature and well-traded the quoted line is, so a freshly-opened, unmoved line gets a wider band than a heavily-traded one. Thin evidence widens this band rather than removing the response. Predictive-framework sports only.

p_model.title: P Model
p_model.description: The fitted model's own probability for this outcome, before blending with the market. Null for any league that does not yet have a model cleared for publication — currently every soccer league. Predictive-framework sports only.

p_market.title: P Market
p_market.description: De-vigged market probability for this outcome, before blending with the model. This is the bookmaker's price with the vig removed across the whole market, so the outcomes of a market sum to 1 — it is not recoverable from a single price by implied-probability arithmetic. Null when the fixture is unpriced. Predictive-framework sports only.

blend_w.title: Blend W
blend_w.description: Weight given to `p_model` when blending it with `p_market` to produce `probability`, 0-1. 0 means the published probability is purely the de-vigged market. Weight is enabled per league and per bet token, and only where the model beat the market out-of-sample, so tokens on the same event can carry different weights. Predictive-framework sports only.

fair_price.title: Fair Price
fair_price.description: American-odds fair price implied by `probability` — the vig-free line. Comparing it to `market.price` gives the bookmaker's margin on this side. Predictive-framework sports only.

edge.title: Edge
edge.description: Expected profit per 1 unit staked at `market.price`, i.e. `probability x decimal_odds - 1`. Positive means the price pays more than the probability justifies. Null whenever `blend_w` is 0: a probability taken from the market has no honest edge against the price it came from, so reporting one would just be restating the vig. Predictive-framework sports only.

sufficiency.title: Sufficiency
sufficiency.description: How much evidence backs this assessment, 0-1, and the input that sets `interval` width and caps `tier`. Its inputs depend on what is actually being measured: while `blend_w` is 0 it measures the quoted line's maturity (movement count on the priced book/market and hours since that book's first quote), because there is no model sample to be thin about; once a model carries weight it reflects the model's own sample depth. Predictive-framework sports only.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: 'quant' when the assessment is purely deterministic (ratings, market, and model math). 'full' once a qualitative overlay — lineups, injuries, research alignment — is attached; `alignment` is populated only in that case. Predictive-framework sports only.

model_version.title: Model Version
model_version.description: Identifier of the parameter set that produced this assessment, so a published number can be traced to the version that made it. 'market_anchor' means no fitted model contributed. Per bet, since model weight is enabled per token. Predictive-framework sports only.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.description: Named, signed contributions to `probability` in probability units: {id, input, effect, direction, evidence}. `effect` is the shift in probability attributed to that factor and `direction` is 'up'/'down'/'neutral'. `evidence` is null for quantitative drivers (rating edge, HFA, rest) and, once populated, a list of `{fact_id, as_of}` citations into the Fact Ledger (`lumify_fixture_research`) for evidence-derived drivers — never an embedded quote/URL, which would duplicate that archive. Replaces `signals` for predictive-framework sports. Normally empty when no model contributed (`blend_w` 0); two exceptions carry `effect: 0` and never move probability: Stage 6 Match Context drivers (`soccer.match_context.*`, evidence-backed) and `soccer.cross_book_edge` (market-anchored price gap vs. the sharp consensus; `input` is the gap already published in `edges_by_book` — a line-shopping signal, not an expected-value claim). Predictive-framework sports only.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.description: Qualitative-overlay agreement detail. Populated only when `phase` is 'full'; null for every 'quant' assessment. Predictive-framework sports only.

fair.title: Fair
fair.description: Sharp-consensus fair price for this outcome: {probability, books, n_books, is_consensus}. `probability` is distinct from `p_market` (the *priced* book's own de-vigged probability) and from `fair_price` (American odds implied by the published `probability`, above) — it is the sharp-book reference (`SOCCER_SHARP_BOOKS`) that a cross-book edge is measured against. `is_consensus` is false whenever `n_books` < 2 — a single sharp book is a de-vig, not a consensus (true for every soccer row today: Pinnacle is the only soccer sharp book on our feed). Populated for MLS as of Stage 5 v1 (2026-07-29); null for every other league until its own book-independence screen and multi-book fetch are wired. Predictive-framework sports only.

edges_by_book.title: Edges By Book
edges_by_book.description: Price gap versus the sharp-reference fair probability (`fair.probability`), keyed by bookmaker, for every independently-eligible soft book quoting this outcome — `fair.probability × decimal_odds − 1` at each book's posted price. This is a **price-gap / line-shopping metric**, not an expected-value recommendation: at the current N=2 soft-book coverage (FanDuel/Hard Rock on MLS), the measured winner's-curse component of a max-of-N pick is ~171% of the mean positive gap, and a closing-time backfill simulation of N=2 realized approximately −2.5% on the positive-gap population (see SOCCER_PROGRAM_PLAN.md §5.0 steps E / tenth pass). Rank soft books by these gaps for line-shopping (largest gap = furthest above the sharp reference); do not treat a positive gap as EV or as a bet recommendation, and do not badge picks as '+EV'. Populated for MLS as of Stage 5 v1; null for every other league until its own gate and fetch are wired, and null for any market with no eligible soft book quoting it. Predictive-framework sports only.

best.title: Best
best.description: Highest price-gap pick across `edges_by_book`: {book, price, edge, quote_age_seconds}. `edge` is the field's raw maximum (`shrinkage=0.0` — winner's-curse correction closed as won't-fit at N=2). Same caveats as `edges_by_book`: this is a price gap versus a de-vigged sharp reference, **not** an expected-value claim; at N=2 the winner's-curse magnitude is ~171% of the mean positive gap and a closing-time N=2 backfill simulation realized ≈−2.5% on positive-gap picks. Use `best.book`/`best.price` as the line-shopping target for this outcome; do not read `best.edge` as EV or as a bet recommendation. `quote_age_seconds` is `best.book`'s posted-price age at publish time — a stale soft-book price is excluded before selection (30-minute freshness threshold). Populated for MLS as of Stage 5 v1 (2026-07-29); null for every other league or whenever `edges_by_book` is empty. Predictive-framework sports only.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: The MCP tool / SDK call to estimate, e.g. 'get_event', 'batch_get_events', 'get_odds'. See GET /v1/estimate/tools for the full supported list.

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Same arguments you'd pass to that tool/endpoint, e.g. {"event_id": 123, "include_odds": true}.

calls.title: Calls
calls.description: One or more planned calls to estimate in a single round-trip.

min_credits.title: Min Credits
min_credits.description: Cheapest realistic outcome (e.g. requested data not yet available).

max_credits.title: Max Credits
max_credits.description: Priciest realistic outcome (e.g. all requested data is available).

note.title: Note
note.description: Why the cost varies, when it does.

event_id.title: Event Id
event_id.description: Lumify event ID this intelligence describes. Present on the standalone endpoint; omitted when inlined under an event via include_intelligence.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when no intelligence has been computed for this event yet — every other field is then null/empty and the request is not charged.

odds_source.title: Odds Source
odds_source.description: Bookmaker `bets[].market` prices were sourced from. For predictive-framework sports this is the assessment's market_book (not a live `?bookmaker=` overlay). For legacy sports it follows the system default or `?bookmaker=` when that override is used.

league.title: League
league.description: League slug for this event, if any.

players.title: Players
players.description: Home/away (or p1/p2) participant identification, keyed by role: {role: {name, player_id, team_id}}.

has_recommend.title: Has Recommend
has_recommend.description: True when at least one bet meets the recommendation threshold; false when none do; null when intelligence has not been computed for this event. For predictive-framework sports a recommendation requires an `edge`, so this is false for any event whose bets are all market-anchored (`blend_w` 0).

analyst_take.title: Analyst Take
analyst_take.description: Short natural-language read on the event as a whole (as opposed to a single bet). Null when no narrative has been generated.

match_overview.title: Match Overview
match_overview.description: Longer natural-language preview of the matchup — form, context, and what to watch. Null when no narrative has been generated.

intelligence_updated_at.title: Intelligence Updated At
intelligence_updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent change anywhere in this payload — the maximum of the per-bet `computed_at` values for predictive-framework sports. Because individual markets are only rewritten when they move, use the per-bet `computed_at` to reason about a specific bet rather than this event-level maximum.

bets.title: Bets
bets.description: One entry per priced bet token. Which fields are populated depends on whether the sport/league is on the predictive framework (probability/edge fields) or the legacy points engine (confidence_score/signals fields) — see BetIntelligence. Outcomes of the same market sum to 1 for predictive-framework sports.

matchup.title: Matchup
matchup.description: MLB-only probable-starter context (home_starter/away_starter with name/hand/era/confirmed), extracted from research context. Absent for every other sport.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.description: Most-recent-first past meetings between these two teams, up to `window`.

home_runs.title: Home Runs
home_runs.description: Runs scored by this event's home team in that past meeting.

away_runs.title: Away Runs
away_runs.description: Runs scored by this event's away team in that past meeting.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when no lineup has been ingested yet for this side.

starting_pitcher.description: This side's starting pitcher. Null when unavailable.

bench.title: Bench
bench.description: Players who entered the game but weren't in the starting lineup (pinch hitters, relievers, defensive subs).

captured_at.title: Captured At
captured_at.description: When this lineup was captured from the source, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.

batting_order.title: Batting Order
batting_order.description: Batting order slot (1-9) for starters with role='batter'. Null for pitchers and subs.

source.title: Source
source.description: Provenance tag, e.g. 'player_game_stats_sum' (own box scores, summed to team level).

window.title: Window
window.description: Which rolling window this block covers: 'l5' (see `window_size` for the fixed game count) or 'season' (an intentionally variable-length window — see `games` for how many games it actually covers for this team).

window_size.title: Window Size
window_size.description: Fixed sample depth for this window, only present when the window has one (e.g. 5 for 'l5'). Omitted for 'season' — use `games` instead.

games.title: Games
games.description: Games with box-score data included in this aggregate.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Avg. team runs scored per game.

home_runs.title: Home Runs
home_runs.description: Avg. team home runs per game.

walks.title: Walks
walks.description: Avg. team walks (bases on balls) drawn per game.

strikeouts.title: Strikeouts
strikeouts.description: Avg. team batter strikeouts per game.

stolen_bases.title: Stolen Bases
stolen_bases.description: Avg. team stolen bases per game.

batting_avg.title: Batting Avg
batting_avg.description: Team batting average across the window: total hits / total at-bats (not an average of per-game averages).

outs.title: Outs
outs.description: Avg. team outs recorded per game. The additive unit behind innings_pitched/ERA/WHIP/K9/BB9.

innings_pitched.title: Innings Pitched
innings_pitched.description: Avg. team innings pitched per game as true innings (total outs ÷ 3 ÷ games). Not baseball notation — see starting_pitcher.innings_pitched for N.outs display.

earned_runs.title: Earned Runs
earned_runs.description: Avg. team earned runs allowed per game.

hits_allowed.title: Hits Allowed
hits_allowed.description: Avg. team hits allowed per game.

walks_allowed.title: Walks Allowed
walks_allowed.description: Avg. team walks allowed per game.

strikeouts_pitched.title: Strikeouts Pitched
strikeouts_pitched.description: Avg. team pitcher strikeouts recorded per game.

home_runs_allowed.title: Home Runs Allowed
home_runs_allowed.description: Avg. team home runs allowed per game.

era.title: Era
era.description: Team ERA across the window: (total earned runs × 9) / (total outs ÷ 3). Uses outs math — baseball IP notation (.1/.2 = outs) is not additive.

whip.title: Whip
whip.description: Team WHIP across the window: (total walks allowed + total hits allowed) / (total outs ÷ 3).

k9.title: K9
k9.description: Team strikeouts per 9 innings across the window: (total pitcher strikeouts × 9) / (total outs ÷ 3).

bb9.title: Bb9
bb9.description: Team walks allowed per 9 innings across the window: (total walks allowed × 9) / (total outs ÷ 3).

field_games.title: Field Games
field_games.description: Per-field sample size, keyed by the raw box-score slugs summed into the fields above (at_bats, hits, runs, home_runs, walks, strikeouts, doubles, stolen_bases, outs, innings_pitched, earned_runs, hits_allowed, walks_allowed, strikeouts_pitched, home_runs_allowed). `games` is how many games are in this window overall, but an individual field can have a smaller count when a box score omits that stat.

window.title: Window
window.description: Number of trailing completed games this form line covers.

results.title: Results
results.description: Most-recent-first results over `window`: 'W' or 'L' (no ties in MLB).

runs_scored.title: Runs Scored
runs_scored.description: Runs this team scored in each game, same order as `results`.

runs_allowed.title: Runs Allowed
runs_allowed.description: Runs this team allowed in each game, same order as `results`.

win_pct.title: Win Pct
win_pct.description: wins / games. Null with zero games.

runs_for.title: Runs For
runs_for.description: Total runs scored this season to date.

runs_against.title: Runs Against
runs_against.description: Total runs allowed this season to date.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when either team hasn't resolved for this fixture yet — every other field is omitted in that case and the call isn't billed.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when no starting pitcher has been identified for this side yet (lineup not ingested).

position.title: Position
position.description: Position abbreviation from the lineup (typically 'P'; may be 'DH' etc. for two-way players).

games_started.title: Games Started
games_started.description: Season-to-date games started (boxscore gamesStarted=1 only — relief appearances do not count).

innings_pitched.title: Innings Pitched
innings_pitched.description: Season-to-date total innings pitched in baseball notation (e.g. 128.1 = 128⅔), derived from summed outs.

era.title: Era
era.description: Season-to-date ERA: (total earned runs × 9) / (total outs ÷ 3) — derived from our own box scores, not a live vendor fetch.

whip.title: Whip
whip.description: Season-to-date WHIP: (total walks allowed + total hits allowed) / (total outs ÷ 3).

bb9.title: Bb9
bb9.description: Season-to-date walks allowed per 9 innings (outs-based denominator).

rest_days.title: Rest Days
rest_days.description: Days since this team's previous completed game.

record.description: Season-to-date W/L record and run differential.

rates_l5.description: Team batting/pitching rate aggregates over the trailing 5 games.

rates_season.description: Team batting/pitching rate aggregates over the current season.

starting_pitcher.description: This side's starting pitcher for this game, with his own season rate stats.

recent_form.title: Recent Form
recent_form.description: Trailing games covered by each team's `recent_form`.

rates_l5.title: Rates L5
rates_l5.description: Trailing games covered by each team's `rates_l5`.

rates_season.title: Rates Season
rates_season.description: Always the literal string 'season' — a deliberately variable-length window (see each team's `rates_season.games`), unlike the fixed integer windows above.

head_to_head.title: Head To Head
head_to_head.description: Trailing meetings between these two teams considered for `head_to_head`.

query.title: Query
query.description: Free text, e.g. 'live nfl games today' or 'college basketball this week'.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Overrides any limit parsed from the query text. Max 100.

interpreted.description: The GET /v1/events filters parsed from the query text.

unrecognized_terms.title: Unrecognized Terms
unrecognized_terms.description: Query words that didn't map to a known filter.

equivalent_request.title: Equivalent Request
equivalent_request.description: The literal GET /v1/events request this query was translated to.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.description: Most-recent-first past meetings between these two teams, up to `window`.

home_goals.title: Home Goals
home_goals.description: Goals scored by this event's home team in that past meeting.

away_goals.title: Away Goals
away_goals.description: Goals scored by this event's away team in that past meeting.

avg_goals_per_team.title: Avg Goals Per Team
avg_goals_per_team.description: League-wide average goals scored per team per game this season, used as the baseline the /intelligence layer compares each team's attack/defense against. Null for competitions that use a fixed baseline instead (e.g. World Cup).

available.title: Available
available.description: False when no lineup has been ingested yet for this side.

captured_at.title: Captured At
captured_at.description: When this lineup was captured from the source, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.

formation_place.title: Formation Place
formation_place.description: Slot index within the formation, when ESPN provides one.

window.title: Window
window.description: Which rolling window this block covers: 'l5' (see `window_size` for the fixed game count) or 'season' (an intentionally variable-length window — see `games` for how many games it actually covers for this team).

window_size.title: Window Size
window_size.description: Fixed sample depth for this window, only present when the window has one (e.g. 5 for 'l5'). Omitted for 'season', since season length varies by team — use `games` instead.

games.title: Games
games.description: Games with box-score data included in this average.

shots_on_target_for.title: Shots On Target For
shots_on_target_for.description: Avg. shots on target taken per game.

shots_on_target_against.title: Shots On Target Against
shots_on_target_against.description: Avg. shots on target conceded per game.

yellow_cards.title: Yellow Cards
yellow_cards.description: Avg. yellow cards received per game.

red_cards.title: Red Cards
red_cards.description: Avg. red cards received per game.

passes.title: Passes
passes.description: Avg. total passes per game (ESPN totalPasses; see pass_accuracy_pct for completion rate).

save_rate.title: Save Rate
save_rate.description: Saves / shots on target faced across the window (not an average of per-game rates).

field_games.title: Field Games
field_games.description: Per-field sample size, keyed by the metric names above. `games` is how many games are in this window overall, but an individual field can have a smaller count when a source's box score omits that stat for some fixtures — lets agents tell 'averaged over all N games' apart from 'averaged over fewer'.

window.title: Window
window.description: Number of trailing completed games this form line covers.

goals_scored.title: Goals Scored
goals_scored.description: Goals this team scored in each game, same order as `results`.

goals_conceded.title: Goals Conceded
goals_conceded.description: Goals this team conceded in each game, same order as `results`.

available.title: Available

neutral_site.title: Neutral Site
neutral_site.description: Whether this fixture is at a neutral venue. Informational here — not used in any of this endpoint's own aggregates, but factored into home-advantage scoring on GET /v1/events/{id}/intelligence.

window.title: Window

avg_opp_rank.title: Avg Opp Rank
avg_opp_rank.description: Average league-table rank of the opponents faced in `window`.

rest_days.title: Rest Days
rest_days.description: Days since this team's previous completed game.

rates_l5.description: Boxscore rate averages over the trailing 5 games.

rates_season.description: Boxscore rate averages over the current season/edition.

rates_l5.description: Trailing games covered by each team's `rates_l5`.

sos.title: Sos
